facts.big: How much are they? · a pound · a dozen
facts.label: Comprar na feira
facts.sub: Pergunte How much are they? e entenda Two dollars a pound. Peça com I want three pounds, please e One dozen, please. Confira o total com That is twelve dollars.

facts.label: Feira de produtores
facts.sub: As feiras de produtores acontecem aos fins de semana em praças e parques. Os agricultores vendem frutas, legumes, ovos, mel e pães direto ao cliente.

facts.label: Libras e dúzias
facts.sub: O peso das frutas é dado em libras (pounds). Uma libra é cerca de 450 gramas. Os ovos são vendidos em dúzias, ou seja, doze unidades.

paragraphs: It is Saturday morning at the farmers market in Austin. White tents stand in long rows under the sun. Ivy walks slowly with a basket on her arm. Everything looks colorful and fresh. At the third tent, Gus waves to her. Red apples shine in a wooden box.
“Good morning! Fresh apples today.” says Gus. “They look great. How much are they?” says Ivy. “Two dollars a pound.” says Gus.
